name: @refarm.dev/vault-surface-ref
description: Reference vault:v1 surface — a pure-compute WASM component (world vault-surface) built from TS via componentize-js, proving the sovereign vault plugin boundary end-to-end.

scripts.build:component: jco componentize src/surface.js --wit ../vault-contract-v1/wit/vault.wit --world-name vault-surface --disable all -o dist/vault_surface.wasm && jco transpile dist/vault_surface.wasm -o pkg --name vault_surface --no-wasi-shim --instantiation async
